section.div: OptiScaler bridges upscaling/frame gen across GPUs. Supports DLSS2+/XeSS/FSR2+ inputs, replaces native upscalers, enables FSR-FG/XeFG on non-FG titles. Supports Nukem mod for DLSSG-to-FSR3 FG.
World-class docs for everything you ship. Fast, AI-ready, and zero-config.
Open-source Windows and Office activator featuring HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS activation methods, along with advanced troubleshooting.
